character.appendages: Exactly two short horn/crest points attached to the upper body. Their separation, fold and sweep follow the source pose; no arms, legs, ears, tail or independent floating ornaments.
character.contactAndOrigin: Fixed NCER origin [24, 38] in a logical 64x64 canvas at native scale 1. Never recenter or autofit individual cells. Preserve Main/Sub aliases, translations and all 53 raw sequences with original ticks, loops and stops.
character.faceAndExpression: The small front face/aperture expands in tall expression poses and compresses or disappears in low/prone poses. Preserve per-cell visibility and do not stamp one identical smile on every frame.
character.locomotion: The entire soft body bobs, compresses, curls, stretches vertically, sweeps horizontally and collapses flat. Preserve every tall/flat extreme and never invent walking limbs.
character.morphology: Catalog record 13, generation1, familyBits0. Tiny limbless soft blob with one continuous rounded body, a low front facial aperture and exactly two short horn-like points on the upper edge. It is neither biped nor quadruped.
character.restraint: Main027..043 are restrained variants: a gold binding wraps the central soft body while the face and paired upper points remain readable. The wrap follows upright, curled and flat poses and never becomes anatomy.
character.specialStates: Main044/046 orange-red, 047/048 black silhouettes, 061 stone/gray and 064 white silhouette. Derive deterministically only when alpha/palette relations are proved; otherwise author once.

designLimitations: The donor motion contract is reviewed. The original replacement identity must remain a limbless two-crest soft body and still requires multi-pose generation review before runtime promotion.
